locations.notes: userdata/<id> holds cloud saves, screenshots, and per-user game data — this is the actual library of saves. compatdata holds Proton prefixes (incl. saves) on the Linux side.
config/loginusers.vdf holds account names. Validate before reapply; never trust refresh tokens — re-login on the new install.
Depot/app/shader caches and logs rebuild on launch. Nothing user-authored lives here.
Game binaries are tens/hundreds of GB of third-party executables. Steam verify-and-repair / redownload beats a hostile copy every time. The Steam client itself reinstalls via Chocolatey.
